source_text.GH#2702: Hide synthetic entity-type instances from every Instances route (PR-0b, SECURITY).

task.description: Implement the GH #2702 design. No tests written.

result.summary: Code written per design, NOT compiled: the machine mix mutex (AppData/Local/Temp/claude/mixlock) was held by another session for the whole 8 min wait, so no mix command (compile, format, check_boundaries) was run. New: lib/letflow/event_store/instance_visibility.ex (exclude_synthetic/2 NOT EXISTS via parent_as with explicit query-level prefix; synthetic?/2). Applied in instances.ex (list, get_by_id, ensure_instance_exists), engine.ex cancel lock, engine/pin_rebind.ex lock, engine/reconstruction.ex (ensure_visible_projection before select_replay_source, :instance_not_found), routers/instances.ex (pins guard via synthetic?/2, moduledoc note on TENANT_AUDITOR until REQ-516 #2701), entities/entity_type_instance.ex create_and_reselect reorder (registry insert, re-read winner, ensure projection for winner only). authorization.ex and priv/permission_matrix/effective.golden untouched. Compile risks to check first: from(p in query, as: :instance_projection_visibility) alias and parent_as inside exists/1; existing reconstruct tests that reconstruct a projection-less instance now get :instance_not_found.
